intro.title: What is the MAP TEST?
intro.body: MAP TEST stands for "Measures of Academic Progress" — an academic-achievement assessment developed by NWEA (Northwest Evaluation Association), a U.S. educational evaluation and learning-diagnostic organization.

importance.title: Why MAP TEST matters
importance.i1: Achievement assessment aligned to the U.S. Common Core State Standards
importance.i2: Entrance exam used by international schools

features.title: What makes TPI different
features.f1-title: Accurate diagnosis through the official NWEA MAP TEST and online trial classes
features.f1-body: Built on the globally trusted NWEA MAP TEST, we precisely analyze the student's level and strengths. A free online trial class objectively measures real-class adaptability and performance.
features.f2-title: TPI's 2,000+ proprietary item bank — past papers and original content
features.f2-body: Years of accumulated past-paper analysis and in-house research drive a practice-oriented curriculum that fully reflects current exam trends.
features.f3-title: MAP TEST specialist faculty plus international-school curriculum consultants
features.f3-body: Faculty deeply versed in international and overseas curricula deliver individualized learning strategies aligned to each student's goals.
features.f4-title: A structured feedback system that surfaces learning progress and outcomes
features.f4-body: Diagnostic results and learning trajectories are summarized in feedback reports parents and students can read at a glance.
features.f5-title: 1:1 tailored tutoring that owns the path to your target score
features.f5-body: Step-by-step coaching from concept to practice, calibrated to each student's level and target score, with steady management driving target-score achievement.

principle.title: For the growth of each student
principle.p1: Trinity respects each student's learning pace, disposition, and goals. Even within the same grade, no two students receive the same curriculum. We clarify the starting point through MAP diagnostics and read disposition via TPI (Trinity Profile Index) to propose a path that fits each learner.
principle.p2: At the center of our shield crest sit the T and cross, three stars, a crown, and a pennant. Scholarship, faith, integrity, and community — these four values form the foundation of Trinity's education.
